# Vendored scripts

| File | What | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `floating-ui.core.umd.min.js`, `floating-ui.dom.umd.min.js` | Floating UI: places the game's tooltips so they stay on the screen (js/tips.js) | 1.8.0, from the npm packages `@floating-ui/core` and `@floating-ui/dom` | MIT (`floating-ui.LICENSE.txt`) |

Kept in the repository, not loaded from a CDN: every window's detail lives in its tooltips, and they must work offline.
